title: pinout-openapi contract-tests config (input DTO)
description: Input DTO for the one-shot CLI `pinout-openapi validate <config.yaml>`. Assembled by the cli-io door into ONE flat Request handed to the head. Derived from FRD Data dictionary A + UC-1 (slice-01-validate). Symmetric with the twin pinout-asyncapi/contract-tests.yaml — sync-specific: `operations` (path+method) instead of `channels`; provider spec via `spec_path` XOR `spec_url`. FROZEN: this is the sole input contract of the service.

consumer.description: The consumer under test and the operation scope to check (only these operations are compared).

consumed_contract_path.description: Path to the E-harness `consumed-contract` artifact (schema-shaped, typed, + provenance). Missing/unreadable at runtime → FILE_NOT_FOUND (exit 3); unparseable → PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

operations.description: Comparison scope: the operations (path+method) the consumer depends on. Only these are checked; provider operations outside this set are informational (report.uncovered_operations[]).

path.description: OpenAPI path template, e.g. `/users/{id}`. Violation → CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

provider.description: The provider master OpenAPI spec, reachable via EXACTLY ONE of `spec_path` (local file) or `spec_url` (HTTP GET). Both-set or neither-set → CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

spec_path.description: Path to a local OpenAPI file (parsed by kin-openapi, $ref resolved). Mutually exclusive with `spec_url`. Missing → FILE_NOT_FOUND (exit 3); unparseable → PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

spec_url.description: http(s) URL to the raw OpenAPI spec (HTTP GET). Mutually exclusive with `spec_path`. Private URLs authenticated via header `Authorization: Bearer $PINOUT_PROVIDER_TOKEN` sourced from env only (never config/git). Unreachable/non-2xx → HTTP_ERROR (exit 3); fetch > `settings.timeout` → TIMEOUT_ERROR (exit 3); unparseable body → PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

settings.description: Optional run settings; all defaulted, all symmetric with the twin. Any invalid value → CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

save_json_report.description: When true, write the schema-valid JSON report (report.schema.json) to `json_report_file` for pinout-netlist/E2 aggregation.

timeout.description: Max seconds to fetch a provider `spec_url`; exceed → TIMEOUT_ERROR (exit 3).

ignore_warnings.description: Reserved (twin symmetry): consider only breaking changes.
